prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and whether you need AI for creative/content, performance (paid media), personalization/CRM, or analytics. If you tell me what you want to achieve I can shortlist agencies that match. Meanwhile, here’s a quick, practical guide:

Quick questions
- What’s your top goal? (brand awareness, sales/lead generation, personalization, creative automation, analytics/attribution)
- Monthly/annual budget range?
- Company size (startup, SMB, enterprise) and industry?
- Timeline for results?
Answering these will let me give a targeted recommendation.

Types of agencies and who they’re best for
- Performance & programmatic (AI for bidding, media optimization): best if you want ROI-driven paid search, social and programmatic advertising.
  - Examples to consider: Wpromote (LA-based, strong performance/automation focus), Cognitiv (AI-first programmatic tech/strategies).
- Data, personalization & CRM (AI-driven customer journeys, recommendation engines):
  - Examples: Merkle, Accenture Interactive / Deloitte Digital (larger consultancies with data & personalization practices).
- Creative & content automation (AI-assisted creative, generative content at scale):
  - Examples: R/GA, VaynerMedia, Ogilvy (network agencies with AI/creative labs).
- Boutique / AI-first startups (rapid experimentation, custom models):
  - Examples: smaller LA boutiques and AI startups that focus solely on generative AI, model fine-tuning, and proprietary optimization engines.

How to evaluate and pick “the best” for you
- Case studies: look for results tied to KPIs similar to yours (CAC, ROAS, conversion lift).
- Tech stack & IP: do they build custom models or mainly use off‑the‑shelf tools (OpenAI, Google, Meta)?
- Data handling & privacy: can they securely connect your first-party data? What are their data-retention and compliance practices?
- Team composition: do they have both data scientists/ML engineers and marketers/creatives?
- Measurement & transparency: do they provide clear measurement, holdouts/A-B tests, and explainable model decisions?
- Pricing model: retainer vs performance-based vs project-based — choose what aligns with risk tolerance.
- References & references from similar verticals.

Practical next steps I can do for you
- If you give me your goals and budget, I’ll produce a 3–5 agency shortlist in LA tailored to you (including contact points and suggested questions to ask).
- Or I can draft an RFP/email template you can send to agencies to quickly compare proposals.

Which direction would you like to go? (Tell me your goal and budget and I’ll make a specific shortlist.)
